rows.question: What was total revenue across all channels for the whole financial year (April 2025 to March 2026)?

arguments.sql:
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
pos_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE t.line_total
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON t.txn_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
      AND t.is_valid = true
),
ecom_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE l.line_total
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON o.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
      AND o.order_status != 'CANCELLED'
),
erp_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.net_value * COALESCE(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1)
                ELSE l.net_value
            END
        ) AS rev
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON l.order_date = f.rate_date
    WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM pos_rev), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM ecom_rev), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM erp_rev), 0)) AS answer

with fx as (
    select rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    from staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
materials as (
    select sku, standard_cost_nzd
    from staging.stg_erp__materials m
    left join reference.material_groups mg on m.material_group = mg.material_group
    where mg.product_category = 'Bakeware'
),
pos_bakeware as (
    select 
        l.line_total as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then l.line_total else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines l
    inner join materials m on l.sku = m.sku
    inner join staging.stg_erp__stores s on l.store_id = s.store_id
    where l.txn_date >= '2025-04-01' and l.txn_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and l.is_valid = true
      and l.txn_type = 'SALE'
      and s.country = 'New Zealand'
),
ecom_bakeware as (
    select 
        l.line_total as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then l.line_total else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    inner join staging.stg_ecom__orders o on l.order_id = o.order_id
    inner join materials m on l.sku = m.sku
    where o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' and o.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and o.order_status != 'Cancelled'
      and o.region_code in ('NZ', 'AUS')
),
erp_bakeware as (
    select 
        case when l.currency = 'AUD' then l.net_value * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else l.net_value end as net_rev,
        l.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd as total_cost,
        case when m.standard_cost_nzd is not null then 
            case when l.currency = 'AUD' then l.net_value * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else l.net_value end
        else 0 end as costed_rev
    from staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    inner join staging.stg_erp__customers c on l.customer_id = c.customer_id
    inner join materials m on l.material_id = m.sku
    left join fx f on l.order_date = f.rate_date
    where l.order_date >= '2025-04-01' and l.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
      and c.country in ('New Zealand', 'Australia')
),
combined as (
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from pos_bakeware
    union all
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from ecom_bakeware
    union all
    select net_rev, total_cost, costed_rev from erp_bakeware
)
select 
    (sum(net_rev) - sum(total_cost)) / nullif(sum(costed_rev), 0) as answer
from combined

    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines p

pos_calc AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)

                CASE 
                    WHEN currency = 'AUD' THEN line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                    ELSE line_total
                END

    LEFT JOIN materials m ON e.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),

-- 3. Wholesale (ERP Sales Orders) Revenue and Standard Cost
erp_lines AS (
    SELECT 
        l.net_value,
        l.quantity,
        l.currency,
        l.order_date,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON l.material_id = m.material_id

erp_calc AS (

    SELECT rev, costed_rev, total_cost FROM erp_calc

with fx as (
    select rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    from staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
material_categories as (
    select sku, product_category
    from staging.stg_erp__materials
    where sku is not null
),
pos_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum(p.line_total * case when p.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines p
    join staging.stg_erp__stores s on p.store_id = s.store_id
    left fx f on p.txn_date = f.rate_date
    join material_categories m on p.sku = m.sku
    where p.txn_date >= '2025-12-01' and p.txn_date <= '2025-12-31'
      and p.txn_type = 'SALE'
      and p.is_valid = true
    group by 1
),
ecom_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum((ol.line_total - coalesce(ol.discount_amount, 0)) * case when o.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol
    join staging.stg_ecom__orders o on ol.order_id = o.order_id
    left fx f on o.order_date = f.rate_date
    join material_categories m on ol.sku = m.sku
    where o.order_date >= '2025-12-01' and o.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
      and o.order_status != 'Cancelled'
    group by 1
),
erp_rev as (
    select
        m.product_category,
        sum(sol.net_value * case when sol.currency = 'AUD' then coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0) else 1.0 end) as rev
    from staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
    left fx f on sol.order_date = f.rate_date
    join staging.stg_erp__materials m on sol.material_id = m.material_id
    where sol.order_date >= '2025-12-01' and sol.order_date <= '2025-12-31'
    group by 1
),
combined as (
    select product_category, rev from pos_rev
    union all
    select product_category, rev from ecom_rev
    union all
    select product_category, rev from erp_rev
)
select product_category as answer
from combined
group by 1
order by sum(rev) desc
limit 1

arguments.sql:
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),

-- 1. POS Revenue
pos_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        s.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN t.currency = 'AUD' THEN t.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE t.line_total
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON t.txn_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE t.txn_date >= '2025-06-01' AND t.txn_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND t.is_valid = true
    GROUP BY s.region_code
),

-- 2. Ecom Revenue (Excludes cancelled web orders, net of refunds if handled via line totals/status, 
-- stg_ecom__orders has order_status. Let's check non-cancelled orders).
ecom_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN o.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.line_total * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.line_total
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l ON o.order_id = l.order_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON o.order_date = fx.rate_date
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-06-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30'
      AND LOWER(o.order_status) != 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY o.region_code
),

-- 3. ERP (Wholesale) Revenue
erp_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        c.region_code,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN l.currency = 'AUD' THEN l.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE l.net_value
            END
        ) AS revenue
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(
        COALESCE(pos_rev, 0) + COALESCE(ecom_rev, 0) + COALESCE(erp_rev, 0) 
        AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
    ) AS answer
FROM 
    (
        -- 1. POS Revenue for NZ in May 2025
        SELECT SUM(l.line_total) AS pos_rev
        FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines l
        JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
        WHERE s.country = 'New Zealand'
          AND l.txn_date >= '2025-05-01' AND l.txn_date <= '2025-05-31'
          AND l.is_valid = TRUE
    ) p
    CROSS JOIN (
        -- 2. E-commerce Revenue for NZ in May 2025 (Completed/Valid orders, net of refunds/discounts represented in line totals)
        -- Note: Excludes shipping fees and cancelled web orders as per business definition for net revenue.
        SELECT SUM(l.line_total) AS ecom_rev
        FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
        JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE o.region_code IN (
            SELECT region_code FROM reference.regions WHERE country = 'New Zealand'
        )
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-05-31'
        AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    ) e
    CROSS JOIN (
        -- 3. Wholesale (ERP) Revenue for NZ in May 2025, handling AUD to NZD conversion if applicable
        SELECT SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN sol.currency = 'AUD' THEN sol.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE sol.net_value
            END
        ) AS erp_rev
        FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
        JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON sol.customer_id = c.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON sol.order_date = fx.rate_date
        WHERE c.country = 'New Zealand'
          AND sol.order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND sol.order_date <= '2025-05-31'
    ) erp

Which sales channel had the highest gross margin over the financial year?

arguments.sql:
WITH fy_dates AS (
    SELECT '2025-04-01'::date AS start_date, '2026-03-31'::date AS end_date
),

fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),

-- 1. POS Channel
pos_lines AS (
    SELECT
        t.txn_date AS tx_date,
        t.sku,
        t.quantity,
        (t.line_total - COALESCE(t.discount_amount, 0)) AS net_amount,
        s.country
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE t.txn_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
      AND t.is_valid = true
      AND t.txn_type IN ('SALE', 'REFUND')
),
pos_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        p.tx_date,
        p.sku,
        p.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN p.country = 'Australia' THEN p.net_amount * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE p.net_amount
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM pos_lines p
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON p.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON p.tx_date = fx.rate_date
),
pos_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'POS' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM pos_mapped
),

-- 2. Web Shop Channel
ecom_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, order_date, currency, region_code
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE order_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
      AND order_status != 'CANCELLED'
),
ecom_lines_base AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_date,
        l.sku,
        l.quantity,
        (l.line_total - COALESCE(l.discount_amount, 0)) AS net_amount,
        o.region_code
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN ecom_orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
),
ecom_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_date,
        e.sku,
        e.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.region_code LIKE 'AU%' THEN e.net_amount * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE e.net_amount
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM ecom_lines_base e
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON e.sku = m.sku
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),
ecom_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Web Shop' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM ecom_mapped
),

-- 3. Wholesale Channel (ERP Sales Orders)
erp_lines_base AS (
    SELECT
        l.order_date,
        l.material_id,
        l.quantity,
        l.net_value,
        c.country
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_dates f
    WHERE l.order_date BETWEEN f.start_date AND f.end_date
),
erp_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_date,
        e.net_value,
        e.quantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN e.country = 'Australia' THEN e.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE e.net_value
        END AS net_nzd,
        m.standard_cost_nzd
    FROM erp_lines_base e
    LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON e.material_id = m.material_id
    LEFT JOIN fx ON e.order_date = fx.rate_date
),
erp_agg AS (
    SELECT
        'Wholesale' AS sales_channel,
        SUM(net_nzd) AS revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd ELSE 0 END) AS costed_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN net_nzd - (quantity * standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_profit
    FROM erp_mapped
),

combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM pos_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ecom_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM erp_agg
)

SELECT sales_channel AS answer
FROM combined
WHERE costed_revenue > 0
ORDER BY (gross_profit / costed_revenue) DESC
LIMIT 1

    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_logistics__shipments
WHERE sales_channel = 'wholesale'
  AND promised_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
  AND promised_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'

What revenue did the Wellington store make in November 2025?

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(t.line_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 4)) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.store_name ILIKE '%Wellington%'
  AND t.txn_date >= DATE '2025-11-01'
  AND t.txn_date <= DATE '2025-11-30'
  AND t.is_valid = TRUE

What was the gross margin on Kitchen Tools sold online from January to March 2026?

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN (ol.line_total - COALESCE(ol.discount_amount, 0)) - (ol.quantity * m.standard_cost_nzd) ELSE 0 END) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL THEN (ol.line_total - COALESCE(ol.discount_amount, 0)) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines ol
JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON ol.sku = m.sku
WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
  AND m.product_category = 'Kitchen Tools'

How many online orders came from the Sydney region in March 2026?

arguments.sql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
JOIN reference.regions r ON o.region_code = r.region_code
WHERE o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Sydney%'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2026-03-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
